name: Utah Valley Open 2019

venue.name: Spanish Fork Fairgrounds Ponderosa Buliding
venue.address: 2409, 475 S Main St, Spanish Fork, UT 84660
venue.details: The venue is located just north of the High Chaparral Building in the Spanish Fork Fairgrounds.

information:
* Cubes will be sold at the competition by Oliver's Twisted Puzzles.
* There will be a 100 person competitor limit.  It is recommended you register as soon as possible to save a spot.
* Volunteers have to clean the venue afterward, so please be careful with outside food and drink.
* Parking is avalable in front of the High Chapperal Building on the Spanish Fork Fairgrounds and is free for the whole day.
* Registration is online only.  No at the door registrations will be accepted.
* Registration is not considered complete until payment has been accepted.
* Be sure to familiarize yourself with the WCA regulations.  If this is your first official competition, [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dPL3eV-A0ww) provides the information you need.
